title.target: Le conditionnel passé : ce qui se serait passé
title.en: Third conditional: what would have happened

ex.t: Je regrette d'avoir quitté ce travail.
ex.ko: 나는 그 직장을 그만둔 것을 후회해요.

ex.t: Si j'avais pris un taxi, je n'aurais pas raté le train.
ex.ko: 택시를 탔더라면 기차를 놓치지 않았을 거예요.
ex.en: If I had taken a taxi, I wouldn't have missed the train.

ex.t: Si j'avais saisi l'occasion, j'habiterais à Paris maintenant.
ex.ko: 그 기회를 잡았더라면 지금 파리에 살고 있을 거예요.
ex.en: If I had taken the chance, I would be living in Paris now.

ex.t: Si le résultat avait été bon, elle aurait été heureuse.
ex.ko: 시험 결과가 좋았더라면 그녀는 기뻐했을 거예요.
ex.en: If the result had been good, she would have been happy.

ex.t: Si nous n'avions pas fait cette erreur, nous aurions gagné.
ex.ko: 그 실수를 안 했더라면 우리가 이겼을 거예요.
ex.en: If we hadn't made that mistake, we would have won.

ex.t: Si je ne l'avais pas rencontré par hasard, nous ne serions pas devenus amis.
ex.ko: 우연히 그를 만나지 않았더라면 우리는 친구가 되지 못했을 거예요.
ex.en: If I hadn't met him by chance, we wouldn't have become friends.

ex.t: Si nous étions partis tôt, nous aurions évité les embouteillages.
ex.ko: 일찍 출발했더라면 교통 체증을 피했을 거예요.
ex.en: If we had left early, we would have avoided the traffic.

ex.t: S'il avait porté un casque, il ne se serait pas blessé.
ex.ko: 헬멧을 썼더라면 그는 다치지 않았을 거예요.
ex.en: If he had worn a helmet, he wouldn't have got hurt.

ex.t: Si seulement j'avais étudié plus sérieusement à l'époque !
ex.ko: 그때 더 열심히 공부했더라면 좋았을 텐데.
ex.en: If only I had studied harder then.

ex.t: Si j'avais choisi un autre chemin, tout aurait été différent.
ex.ko: 다른 길을 택했다면 모든 것이 달라졌을 거예요.
ex.en: If I had chosen another path, everything would have been different.

title.en: Third conditional: if + past perfect, conditional perfect

explain.ko: 과거에 실제로 일어나지 않은 일을 가정하고 그 결과를 말할 때는 si + plus-que-parfait(대과거), 주절은 conditionnel passé(조건법 과거)를 씁니다: Si j'avais pris un taxi, je n'aurais pas raté le train. conditionnel passé = avoir/être의 조건법 현재(aurais, serais …) + 과거분사. 지금까지 이어지는 결과는 주절에 conditionnel présent를 씁니다: Si j'avais pris ce travail, j'habiterais à Paris maintenant. 후회는 Si seulement + plus-que-parfait로 말합니다. 주의: si 뒤에는 conditionnel을 쓰지 않습니다.
explain.en: To imagine something that did not happen in the past and its result, use si + plus-que-parfait with the conditionnel passé in the main clause: Si j'avais pris un taxi, je n'aurais pas raté le train. The conditionnel passé = conditional of avoir / être (aurais, serais …) + past participle. A result that continues now takes the conditionnel présent: Si j'avais pris ce travail, j'habiterais à Paris maintenant. Regret is expressed with Si seulement + plus-que-parfait. Never use the conditional after si.

head: 구조 / Structure
형태 / Forme
예문 / Exemple
rows: … je n'aurais pas raté le train.
Si j'avais pris ce travail, j'habiterais à Paris.
Si seulement j'étais parti plus tôt !

notes.ko: si 뒤에는 conditionnel을 쓰지 않습니다: Si j'avais su, … (O) / Si j'aurais su (X).
notes.en: No conditional after si: Si j'avais su, … (correct), not Si j'aurais su.

notes.ko: être 동사군(aller, partir, arriver…)은 과거분사를 주어에 일치시킵니다: je serais parti(e).
notes.en: Verbs conjugated with être agree with the subject: je serais parti(e).

notes.ko: 과거의 일이 현재까지 영향을 주면 주절은 현재 조건법을 씁니다.
notes.en: If the result is still true now, use the present conditional in the main clause.

lines.t: Qu'est-ce qui se serait passé si vous aviez agi autrement ?

trans.en: (Question) What would have happened if you had acted differently?

options: J'avais pris un autre chemin demain.

lines.t: Qu'auriez-vous fait si vous aviez réussi l'examen ?

trans.en: (Question) What would you have done if you had passed the exam?

lines.t: Comment s'est passé ton entretien hier ?
C'était un désastre. J'ai raté mon train et je suis arrivé en retard.
Si tu avais pris un taxi, tu ne serais pas arrivé en retard.
Je sais. Si seulement j'étais parti plus tôt. Mais ça ne sert à rien de regretter maintenant.

trans.ko:
A: 어제 면접은 어땠어?
B: 망쳤어. 기차를 놓쳐서 늦었거든.
A: 택시를 탔더라면 안 늦었을 텐데.
B: 맞아. 일찍 출발했더라면 좋았을 텐데. 이제 와서 후회해도 소용없지만.
trans.en:
A: How was your interview yesterday?
B: It was a disaster. I missed my train, so I was late.
A: If you had taken a taxi, you wouldn't have been late.
B: I know. If only I had left earlier. It's no use regretting it now, though.

questions.q: Pourquoi B est-il arrivé en retard ?

lines.t: Le week-end dernier, notre équipe a perdu la finale. À la dernière minute, un défenseur a fait une erreur. L'entraîneur a dit que si nous n'avions pas fait cette erreur, nous aurions gagné. Mais les joueurs ont promis de faire mieux au prochain match.

trans.ko: 지난 주말에 우리 팀은 결승전에서 졌어요. 마지막 순간에 수비수가 실수를 했어요. 코치는 말했어요. 그 실수를 안 했더라면 우리가 이겼을 거라고요. 하지만 선수들은 다음 경기에서 더 잘하겠다고 약속했어요.
trans.en: Last weekend our team lost the final. In the last minute a defender made a mistake. The coach said that if we hadn't made that mistake, we would have won. But the players promised to do better in the next match.

options: Sans cette erreur, ils auraient gagné

lines.t: J'ai perdu mon téléphone le mois dernier et je n'avais pas d'assurance.
Ah, si vous aviez souscrit une assurance, vous auriez été couvert.
Oui, je vais en prendre une cette fois. Je pars pour un mois.

trans.ko:
직원: 여행 보험 상담입니다.
손님: 지난달에 휴대폰을 잃어버렸는데 보험이 없었어요.
직원: 아, 가입하셨더라면 보상받으셨을 텐데요.
손님: 네, 이번에는 꼭 가입하겠습니다. 한 달 동안 갑니다.
trans.en:
Agent: Travel insurance advice.
Guest: I lost my phone last month and I had no insurance.
Agent: Ah, if you had taken out insurance, you would have been covered.
Guest: Yes, I'll definitely take it out this time. I'm going for one month.

items.passage: L'année dernière, on m'a proposé un travail à Paris. Mais j'ai refusé à cause de ma famille. Maintenant je me demande parfois comment serait ma vie si j'(1) l'occasion. Mais je ne regrette (2). Grâce à cette décision, j'(3) mes amis d'ici.

trans.ko: 작년에 나는 파리에서 일할 기회를 받았어요. 하지만 가족 때문에 거절했어요. 지금은 가끔 생각해요. 그 기회를 잡았더라면 지금 어떻게 살고 있을까 하고요. 하지만 후회하지는 않아요. 그 결정 덕분에 지금의 친구들을 만났으니까요.
trans.en: Last year I was offered a job in Paris. But I turned it down because of my family. Now I sometimes wonder how my life would be if I had taken the chance. But I don't regret it. Because of that decision I met my friends here.

items.passage:
BLOG
Ma plus grande erreur
À l'université, je suis à peine allé en cours pendant tout un semestre. À la fin, j'ai échoué à un examen important. Si j'avais travaillé sérieusement à ce moment-là, j'aurais probablement un autre métier aujourd'hui. Mais j'ai beaucoup appris de cette erreur.

trans.ko:
블로그
나의 가장 큰 실수
대학 시절 나는 한 학기 동안 수업에 거의 가지 않았어요. 결국 중요한 시험에서 떨어졌어요. 그때 열심히 했더라면 지금쯤 다른 직업을 갖고 있을 거예요. 하지만 그 실수에서 많이 배웠어요.
trans.en:
BLOG
My biggest mistake
At university I hardly went to classes for a whole term. In the end I failed an important exam. If I had worked hard then, I would probably have a different job now. But I learnt a lot from that mistake.

questions.q: Qu'est-ce que l'auteur a fait à l'université ?
options: Il est à peine allé en cours
Beaucoup de choses de son erreur

items.passage: Hier matin, Tom ne s'est pas réveillé et il a raté le bus. Il est arrivé en retard à la réunion et son patron était en colère. Tom s'est dit qu'il aurait dû mettre un deuxième réveil.

trans.ko: 톰은 어제 아침 늦잠을 자서 버스를 놓쳤어요. 그는 회의에 늦었고 상사는 화가 났어요. 톰은 알람을 하나 더 맞췄더라면 좋았을 텐데 하고 생각했어요.
trans.en: Tom overslept yesterday morning and missed the bus. He was late for the meeting and his boss was angry. Tom thought he should have set a second alarm.

questions.q: Le patron de Tom était content.

prompt.ko: 과거의 후회나 놓친 기회에 대해 제3조건문을 사용해 4문장으로 써 보세요.
prompt.en: Write 4 sentences about a past regret or a missed chance, using the third conditional.

task.model: Si j'avais pris un taxi, je n'aurais pas raté le train. Je serais arrivé à l'heure. Si j'avais obtenu ce poste, j'habiterais à Paris maintenant. Si seulement j'étais parti plus tôt !

model_trans.ko: 택시를 탔더라면 기차를 놓치지 않았을 거예요. 그랬다면 제시간에 도착했을 거예요. 그 직장을 얻었더라면 지금 파리에 살고 있을 거예요. 그때 더 일찍 출발했더라면 좋았을 텐데.
model_trans.en: If I had taken a taxi, I wouldn't have missed the train. I would have arrived on time. If I had got the job, I would be living in Paris now. If only I had left earlier.
